title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?
description:
What would actually happen if you fell into a black hole? It depends on the size of the black hole, and the answer is stranger than you think.

Sources:
- NASA Science, Black Hole Basics: https://science.nasa.gov/universe/black-holes/
- Event Horizon Telescope, Sagittarius A* (2022): https://eventhorizontelescope.org/blog/astronomers-reveal-first-image-black-hole-heart-our-galaxy

sources.title: Event Horizon Telescope - First image of Sagittarius A*

scenes.narration: What if you fell into a black hole? Let's find out. And let's hope you packed light.
scenes.headline: WHAT IF YOU FELL INTO A BLACK HOLE?

visual.query: black holes monsters in space artist concept
visual.note: dramatic black hole with accretion disk

scenes.narration: A black hole is matter crushed so tightly that its gravity traps everything, even light. Its edge is called the event horizon. Cross it, and there is no way back.
scenes.headline: GRAVITY TRAPS EVERYTHING. EVEN LIGHT.

visual.query: behemoth black hole found in an unlikely place

scenes.narration: Fall into a small black hole, a few times the mass of our Sun, and gravity pulls your feet far harder than your head. You get stretched like a noodle. Scientists really call this spaghettification.
scenes.headline: SMALL BLACK HOLE: SPAGHETTIFICATION

visual.query: black hole destroys a star illustration

scenes.narration: But pick a giant, like Sagittarius A star at the center of our galaxy, four million times the mass of the Sun, and the pull is gentle at the edge. You would drift across the horizon and feel nothing at all.
scenes.headline: A GIANT IS GENTLE.

visual.query: stars gather in downtown milky way spitzer

scenes.narration: To a friend watching from far away, you would never quite make it. Your image would slow down, turn red, and fade, frozen at the edge.
scenes.headline: TO EVERYONE ELSE, YOU FREEZE.

scenes.narration: For you, the fall goes on, toward a point where our laws of physics simply break down. What happens there? Nobody knows yet.
scenes.headline: WHERE PHYSICS BREAKS DOWN

scenes.narration: Follow Cosmic What If for more mind-bending science.
